variety_description: IGKVR2 also known as Durgashewari, a medium maturity, medium tall variety released by IGKVV, Raipur in 2010. Recommended for irrigated lowland areas of Chattissgarh, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha. Long slender grain with good grain quality. Tolerant to leaf blast, leaf blight, BPH and WBPH. Better tolerance to drought conditions at physiological maturity stage.
